verbatim_quote.original: Strictly read-only on prod: no writes, no deletes, no restarts, no config changes.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Strictly read-only on prod: no writes, no deletes, no restarts, no config changes.

extracted_decision.summary: Mandated a strictly read-only production export: no writes, deletes, restarts or config changes; download from prod only, render/store artifacts on staging or local.
extracted_decision.rationale: PII-sensitive export on a live server; zero-mutation safety rule.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Safety over speed; all artifacts stay off prod.
